description: Finds the aircraft types TrimCarbon has figures for, by name (e.g. "Cessna 172", "Skyhawk"), ICAO type designator (e.g. "C172", "PA28") or page slug. Returns each type with its kg of CO₂ per flight hour. The list covers about 60 general-aviation types, plus a few airliners (per passenger) and business jets.

query.description: A name, ICAO type designator or page slug

name: search_aircraft

kgCo2PerHour.description: kg of CO₂ per flight hour, per passenger when perPassenger

pageUrl.description: The page that explains the figure

perPassenger.description: An airliner seat: the figure is one passenger’s share

slug.description: Page slug; null for airliners and business jets

title: Search aircraft types
